title.en: Menu button that expands into a nav panel

summary.zh-TW: 右上角的「Menu ＋」按鈕本身往左下撐開成導覽面板，按鈕文字像滾輪一樣換成「Close」、＋ 轉成 ×，連結一個一個升起，後方變暗。
summary.en: The “Menu +” button at the top right grows down and left into the navigation panel, its label rolls to “Close”, + turns into ×, links rise one by one and the page behind dims.

text.zh-TW: 按鈕和面板是同一個元素：關著時只有按鈕那麼大，打開時撐開成面板。比「按鈕消失、面板出現」更有連續感，看得出面板是從按鈕來的。
text.en: The button and panel are the same element: closed it’s button-sized, open it grows into the panel. That continuity shows where the panel came from.

text.zh-TW: 打開前先量出按鈕大小和面板內容的實際高度，再建立動畫。內容或畫面寬度改變，動畫也會對。
text.en: Before opening it measures the button and the panel’s real content height, then builds the animation, so it stays correct when content or screen width changes.

text.zh-TW: 外殼靠右上定位，寬高變大時會自然往左下撐開，右上角固定不動。
text.en: The shell is anchored top-right, so growing its width and height naturally expands down and left while the corner stays put.

text.zh-TW: 「Menu」和「Close」上下疊著放在一個遮罩裡，往上移一格就換字，像滾輪。比直接換文字更有回饋感。
text.en: “Menu” and “Close” are stacked in a mask; shifting up one line swaps them like a rolling counter — more tactile than swapping text.
